question: Which of the following birth control methods can cause hormonal imbalance, and probably health issues?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Oral contraceptive pills**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Oral contraceptive pills** are a popular method of **birth control** used by **females**, which involves the **oral administration** of small doses of either **progestogens** or **progestogen-estrogen combinations**.
 
• These pills function by **inhibiting ovulation** and **implantation**, and they also alter the quality of **cervical mucus** to prevent or retard the entry of **sperms** into the **uterus**.
 
• Because they introduce **exogenous hormones** into the female body to override the natural **menstrual cycle**, they can lead to a significant **hormonal imbalance**.
 
• Common **health issues** or side effects associated with these pills include **nausea**, **abdominal pain**, **breakthrough bleeding**, **irregular menstrual cycles**, **breast tenderness**, and **weight gain**. ***Hence, the correct answer is Oral contraceptive pills.***
 
• Other methods like **condoms** or **Copper-T** do not primarily function by altering the systemic **hormonal levels** of the user, making **oral pills** the most likely cause of such imbalances.
